raw: Asoro J. Van Den Kerkhof K. 90+1'

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Sadibou Sane (Metz) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar.

90+5' It looks like Yunis Abdelhamid (Reims) saw red with that tackle. Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Metz.
90+3' Reda Khadra (Reims) fires the ball towards the left side of the goal from close-range, but his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
90+1' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem shows a yellow card to Ibou Sane (Metz) for his blatant foul.
90+1' Ablie Jallow (Metz) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
90+1' Laszlo Boloni has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Joel Asoro (Metz) replacing Kevin Van Den Kerkhof.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
87' Ismael Traore (Metz) heads the ball towards goal, but his effort is saved by the goalkeeper.
86' Substitution. Cheikh Sabaly will be replaced by Ibou Sane (Metz).
86' Lamine Camara comes off the pitch to be replaced by Ablie Jallow (Metz).
85' Laszlo Boloni has decided to make a change. Ismael Traore (Metz) replaces Christophe Herelle.
84' The resulting set piece from Metz is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
84' It is time for a substitution. Amadou Kone (Reims) is on for Valentin Atangana Edoa.
82' Alexandre Oukidja (Metz) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
82' Oumar Diakite (Reims) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
79' 2 - 1 Goal! Junya Ito (Reims) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the top right corner. He makes it 2:1.
78' Yunis Abdelhamid (Reims) unleashes a cannonball of a shot from the edge of the area, but it zips narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Metz will have a goal kick.
78' Oumar Diakite (Reims) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
76' Junya Ito floats in a cross for Sergio Akieme (Reims), whose header from near the penalty spot is really poor and goes well wide of the right post.
73' The manager makes a subsitution with Keito Nakamura (Reims) coming on for Mohamed Daramy.
73' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
72' Junya Ito (Reims) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

71' Joseph Okumu (Reims) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. Reims will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
71' Junya Ito (Reims) is about to take a corner kick.
67' Joseph Okumu (Reims) climbs highest in the box and sends a poor header miles over the crossbar. Very poor attempt.
67' Junya Ito (Reims) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
66' Metz fail to score from a corner as Yehvann Diouf (Reims) leaps to collect the ball.
65' Georges Mikautadze (Metz) makes contact with a cross and strikes a shot that lacks the power to find the back of the net, but the goalkeeper still has to make a good save to keep his effort out.
63' Junya Ito (Reims) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
63' Will Still prepares a substitution. Thomas Foket is replaced by Joseph Okumu (Reims).
63' Sergio Akieme (Reims) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Thibault De Smet.
61' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows his whistle as Junya Ito (Reims) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
60' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Lamine Camara (Metz), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
55' Georges Mikautadze (Metz) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Reims.
55' Lamine Camara (Metz) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

54' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Metz will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
51' What was Yunis Abdelhamid (Reims) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
51' Junya Ito (Reims) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alexandre Oukidja, who smothers the ball.
50' Arthur Atta (Metz) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
49' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows his whistle. Sadibou Sane (Metz) commits a foul after dangerous play. A free kick has been awarded to Reims.
48' Metz can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
48' Matthieu Udol (Metz) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The linesman makes the right call and Metz will have a corner.
47' Junya Ito (Reims) sends a cross into the box, but Alexandre Oukidja comes off his line to gather the ball.
46' Referee Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Yunis Abdelhamid (Reims) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
45+1' Mohamed Daramy (Reims) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Metz will have a goal kick.
45+1' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.

43' Emmanuel Agbadou (Reims) gets in a header from the resulting free kick. It lacks accuracy, however, to bother the keeper and the ball goes a few metres over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Metz will have a goal kick.
42' Yellow card. Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
39' Oumar Diakite (Reims) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows his whistle for a foul.
39' Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) rises high to connect with a lofted pass inside the box, but one of his opponents is in the right place at the right time to thwart him.
37' A decent cross into the box is met first time by Georges Mikautadze (Metz), but his powerful goalbound effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
35' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Maxime Colin walks off the pitch to be replaced by Sadibou Sane (Metz).
35' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) latched on to a precise cross, but his bullet header missed the target. He should have done much better. The ball goes out of play and Metz will have a goal kick.
34' Maxime Colin (Metz) is being forced to leave the pitch in order to receive medical treatment and his team will play with a man short for a few minutes.
32' Maxime Colin (Metz) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

31' Mohamed Daramy (Reims) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. Some classy goalkeeping by Alexandre Oukidja stops the ball out of the bottom right corner. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Metz.
29' Oumar Diakite (Reims) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
28' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Oumar Diakite (Reims) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in.
26' Junya Ito (Reims) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Metz will have a goal kick.
26' Lamine Camara (Metz) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
26' The ball is cleared after Georges Mikautadze (Metz) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
22' Thibault De Smet (Reims) has a shot blocked from inside the box. Corner kick. Reims will have an opportunity.
22' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Reims comes to nothing.
21' Junya Ito (Reims) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
20' Christophe Herelle (Metz) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
17' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Reims.
16' The game is interrupted now, Oumar Diakite (Reims) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
16' Oumar Diakite (Reims) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
14' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Kevin Van Den Kerkhof is the provider as he slips the ball to Arthur Atta (Metz) who simply steers it home from close range. It's 1:1.
12' Goal disallowed! Emmanuel Agbadou (Reims) scores but Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows his whistle for a foul.
11' Thibault De Smet (Reims) will take the corner.
11' Oumar Diakite (Reims) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. It will be a corner kick for Reims.
9' Half-chance! Marshall Munetsi (Reims) plays a pass into the box, but Alexandre Oukidja reacts well to snuff out the attack.
6' Lamine Camara (Metz) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows for a foul.
3' 1 - 0 Goal! Oumar Diakite (Reims) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Reda Khadra, then sends the ball into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
3' Oumar Diakite (Reims) makes a strong challenge and Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows for a foul.
2' Lamine Camara (Metz) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Metz will kick-off.
Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem will referee today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
